Design settings

Basic

Self-contained components, grouped as Actions, Inputs, Feedback, Surfaces and Display. Composites are built from these.

Actions

3

Things a person presses to act: buttons and icon buttons.

Button
What can I do next here?
Comment control
Where do I start commenting on this page, and how many comments are here?
Icon button
Which small, familiar action can I take right here?

Inputs

6

Things a person fills in or chooses: text fields, selects, checkboxes and segmented controls.

Checkbox
Do I want this, yes or no?
Segmented control
Which of these few views or options do I want right now?
Select
Which one of these options do I want?
Hide comments · Off
Switch
Is this on or off right now, and can I flip it?

Three open tasks and the next deadline (sample).

Twelve changes this week (sample).

Name, owner and who can see the project (sample).

Tabs
Which view of this one thing am I looking at, and what are the others?
Text field
What do I need to type here, and is it right?

Feedback

3

What state something is in: status pills and inline alerts.

You can change these settings later from the project page.

Inline alert
What do I need to know before I go on, and what should I do about it?
Pin
Which exact spot is this comment about?
Not started
Status pill
What state is this in?

4

What holds and orders content: cards and list rows.

Weekly review

Card

Release notes

Owners can now rename a workspace and choose who may invite people, from one Settings page. (sample)

Invitations expire after seven days, and a reminder goes out the day before. (sample)

Dialog
